title: prunella grandiflora var. laciniata
intro: Prunella grandiflora var. laciniata, commonly known as selfheal or heal-all, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as wound healing, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects, which contribute to its use in treating various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Prunella grandiflora var. laciniata include its immunomodulatory, antioxidant, and antiviral activities, making it a potential remedy for infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
